text:
marta: Quick sync — launching 'Routescape' initiative to formalize regional segmentation + tenant affinity. Need to align on launch criteria, scope tradeoffs, and customer asks. High-level proposal: 2-tier lanes (edge/core), per-tenant routing controls, and clear canary/fallback paths. Thoughts?
jamie: +1. we should require SLOs per lane and a documented canary flow. want a minimal rollback plan too. :thumbsup:
alex: Proposed measurable launch criteria: docs + perf targets (p50 < 120ms for typical short chats, p95 < 350ms), automated fallback to compatible model variant, and a migration opt-in flag for tenants.
samir: Sales feedback — a couple enterprise customers need EU-only routing and APAC low-latency guarantees. Also they want SLA language for ded. capacity.
lee: operational concerns: cross-region failover will increase egress and billing complexity. need a cost impact estimate before we promise lanes.
jamie: Telemetry must capture: tenant_id, route_bucket, origin_region, failover_reason, and model_variant. Add trace sampling at 5% for end-to-end latency debugging.
dev-bot: deploybot: routescape/proto v0.1 pushed to staging (build #7812).
marta: Owners: infra/scale -> alex; routing & policy -> jamie; product/requirements -> marta; SRE/runbooks -> samir; cost analysis -> lee.
alex: I'll add perf targets and the canary automation checklist to the RFC. linking draft: https://go/internal/routescape/rfc (placeholder)
samir: I'll draft a short runbook skeleton with rollback steps and degraded-mode behavior.
jamie: Implementation note: keep prefix-based KV cache in core lane; for edge lane, use read-through cache with shorter TTLs. That reduces cross-lane cache invalidation risk.
lee: Also flag: if we route across regions for failover, we should expose a cost-warning in Console and an opt-in toggle per tenant.
marta: Action items (next steps): 1) alex: perf + canary checklist (due EOD Wed); 2) samir: runbook draft (due Thu); 3) lee: cost estimate for cross-region failover (due Fri); 4) jamie: telemetry & policy proto (due Thu). We'll reconvene after those artifacts.
jamie: noted. small follow-up: can we gate initial rollout to internal tenants + 2 pilot customers?
marta: yes — internal pilot then 2 pilot customers before broader migration. :white_check_mark:
lee: tagging finance for cost approval once estimate ready.
samir: adding a basic test plan to cover cross-region failover + cache consistency checks.
alex: 👍 I'll open the PR with targets and infra checklist shortly.
